training_cohort: full eligible ACCIDENT cohort; candidate ROI TCN
scope: Off-target episodes in accident clips are not a normal-camera false-alarm rate. This study changes operating thresholds, not model weights or reference deployment defaults.
uncertainty: Paired test-clip bootstrap, fixed models and selected thresholds; calibration-selection uncertainty is not resampled
reference_policy: All predeclared budgets, gates, and hops are reported; 500-clip desktop binaries and defaults remain unchanged
